notes: Who does what in an incentive is set per tab now, instead of one switch for the whole section. Boys Incentive has a manager — who sets what a point is worth and what a sheet yields, records how many sheets were rolled, and corrects anything already saved — and a picker, who puts together their own team for the day and nothing else. A picker's form opens with their own name already in it and no sheet count to enter, and once the team is saved the manager makes any correction. HR, the CEO, MD and a Super Admin still run every incentive, and one person can be made manager of all of them at once, including any added later. Incentive also has its own section in the menu now rather than a row under pay — it is a job you run, not something about your own salary.
